recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，被膜下的副皮質區明顯擴張，形成大片淡染、結節狀的區域，把深染的濾泡推擠到邊緣，這種「淡染副皮質結節」是皮膚病性淋巴結病的特徵。
features: Low-power lymph node with intact capsule and subcapsular sinus
Marked expansion of the paracortex by pale-staining, vaguely nodular areas
Pale zones composed of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm (histiocytes/dendritic cells) at this magnification
Darker lymphoid follicles compressed to the periphery
Nodal architecture preserved; pigment not resolvable at this power
describe_en: Lymph node section at low magnification shows preserved architecture with an intact capsule. The paracortex is markedly expanded by pale-staining, vaguely nodular zones that displace darker-staining lymphoid follicles toward the capsule. At this power the pale areas appear to consist of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, while pigment cannot be assessed. The pattern is consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; high-power review for melanin-laden macrophages and S100/CD1a staining would support it and help exclude involvement by mycosis fungoides.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by mycosis fungoides / Sézary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes effacing the paracortex, which requires high power and TCR clonality testing to exclude.
LCH preferentially involves sinuses with grooved Langerhans cells and eosinophils, often with necrosis, rather than paracortical expansion with melanophages.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background rather than pale nodules of histiocytes and dendritic cells.
Sinus histiocytosis distends the sinuses rather than the paracortex and lacks melanin pigment.
